records.text: A command-level UVU police official told security that the roof area was covered, leaving Brian Harpole with nothing further to do.
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: He comes back and his last correspondence was, I got you covered. ... What else am I to do when a command level person from an accredited police department says, I've got this area?

verification.notes: Harpole publicly made this account and displayed a text exchange in which UVU Police Chief Jeff Long told the private security team that police had the roof area covered. This verifies the communication claim at medium confidence; it does not establish that coverage was actually effective.

records.text: In the interview clip, Harpole described correspondence to Chief Long about student access to Sorensen Center roof walkways near Kirk’s location; he said the request was for controlled access or one of his personnel to be there and that Long replied, "I got you covered." This is Harpole’s account of the exchange.
records.speaker: Brian Harpole

appearances.snippet: This correspondence went to Chief Long (Jeff Long). Hello, Chief Long (Jeff Long). We received this message today from the student group. ... There is a student roof access pretty close to where CK (Charlie Kirk) will be set up at the Utah Valley. ... The Sorensen Center has a couple of staircases that go up to walkways on the roofs. He comes back, and for edification, the Sorensen Center was the building in front of the Losee Center. ... And so, and he comes back, he says, you want access to the roof and came back and said, I was told students have access above us. If this is true, it would be nice to either have it controlled access or allow one of my guys to be there as well, if possible. He comes back and his last correspondence was. ... I got you covered.
